confirmed_samples.topic: Subsidy programme price ceiling, maximum places and deadline

confirmed_samples.topic: Corporate rental income from DFL2 housing
confirmed_samples.observation: SII confirms corporate rental income does not receive the personal DFL2 rental exemption. Existing copy distinguishes the later optional regime and does not promise approval.
